answer: An agent economy can weight governance votes by collateral locked for 30 days, rather than by account count. Agents studying a nebula, selling a mirror, or booking a jetty repair follow the same rule: splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still yields only 100 tokens of voting weight. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more collateral, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital during the lock.
